title: Cyanotype bloom
description: A branching botanical contact print develops from pale paper into deep cobalt as exposure increases.
useCase: Explore a direct material-development reveal for print, photography and generative artwork.
interaction: Develop the print with the exposure slider
reducedMotion: There is no autonomous animation loop. Exposure directly redraws the paper field and botanical reveal.
limitations: Stylized exposure preview, not a photographic chemistry simulation. Original vector specimens over a native WebGL1 paper field; remount after context loss.
look: Grainy cream paper giving way to deep cobalt blue along a soft ragged edge, with three pale fern fronds fanned at centre.
motion: Moving the exposure slider raises a noise-edged development front from bottom to top, turning paper to cobalt, while a gradient mask reveals the fern silhouettes upward; no autonomous loop.
adapt: The paper-to-blue front is `wet` in `FRAGMENT`, driven by `u_control`; fern fronds come from `specimenPath` via `SPECIMENS`, revealed by the `${maskId}-development` gradient mask and `Math.pow(control, 0.38)` opacity. Swap `SPECIMENS` for your own SVG paths and tune `paper` and `blue`.
